# 2 Baruch Chapter 63 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "And those bright waters which you saw which followed those black waters: these are the works of Hezekiah king of Judah, and the coming of Isaiah the prophet,"

**2** "who was a man of renown and of great wisdom, and who spoke many prophecies concerning the coming of the Messiah, and concerning Zion, and concerning Israel; and he prayed for the wrath to be appeased."

**3** "For Hezekiah the king received the letter which was written against him, and he spread it out before the Lord, and he prayed for the help of the Lord."

**4** "And the Mighty One heard him; for Hezekiah was righteous and not a transgressor, as some of the kings who were before him had been."

**5** "And the Lord sent the destroying angel against Sennacherib, and he smote the camp of the Assyrians;"

**6** "and in that night the destroying angel killed a hundred and eighty-five thousand of those who had come against Jerusalem."

**7** "And Hezekiah the king, when he was sick unto death, prayed before the Lord, and the Lord healed him, and he lived fifteen years more."

**8** "And also Sennacherib the king of Assyria was cut off, and he was despised, and he returned home in shame."

**9** "And Hezekiah was preserved from all who had sought to destroy him, and Judah was not taken captive in his day."

**10** "For Hezekiah kept the law, and he offered upon the altar of the Lord; and he established the Passover in Zion."

**11** "These are the fourth bright waters which you saw."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
